name: eBay: bare used datacenter accelerator modules (A100 80GB SXM4 observed)
region: Worldwide listings, heavy US and Hong Kong seller concentration (observed stock explicitly labelled 'US Stock' and 'Hong Kong Stock')
price_basis: USED, BARE SXM4 MODULE (no host server, no HGX baseboard, no cooling shroud/heatsink implied) - 80GB HBM2 variant, 'Tested Grade A Updated Firmware', listing 'Nvidia A100 80GB SXM4 Module 699-2G506-0212-320', captured 2026-10-03, Buy It Now, includes import fees. NOT a node, NOT an 8-GPU system. Comparable same-query asking prices on the same day: $10,887.00 and $12,099.00-12,099.99 for other A100 80GB SXM4 modules; a tested 40GB SXM4 pull asked $2,800.00; a NOT-WORKING 80GB SXM4 asked $6,000.00. Low end of the same query is NOT comparable and is excluded from any inference: bare PCBs with no die and no VRAM listed at $150-$1,500 and a heatsink-only at $59.94 - these are parts, not accelerators.
notes: WHY THIS RECORD IS A CHANNEL RECORD AND NOT A PRICE LIST: a single eBay search page is a snapshot of what happened to be listed that hour, so the figure above is one observed asking price with a named basis, not a market rate. Treat the confidence as low-permanence and re-verify before quoting. STRUCTURAL FINDING WORTH MORE THAN THE NUMBER: for H100/H200 the search returned NO complete accelerator modules at all - 37 results for 'nvidia h200' consisted of blower fan kits ($44.99), an H200 NVL heatsink ($190.00), NVLink bridge boards ($500.00 for a 2-slot H200 NVL bridge, $1,985.00 for the 4-way 900-23946-0000-000), SXM5-to-PCIe adapter boards (~$969.98-$1,200.00), and HGX H100/H200 8-GPU HMC baseboards at $1,849.95-$3,000.00 - with zero working H200 SXM modules among them. In other words current-generation datacenter silicon is effectively ABSENT from the open consumer marketplace, and what trades is the ecosystem around it (adapters, bridges, baseboards, spares). A100 80GB SXM4 is the newest accelerator that still moves as a bare module there. Filter counts on the H200 search also showed 22 New / 16 Open box / 7 Used, but the high end of its price facet was only $41,250 - far below a real H200, confirming that no complete H200 was present rather than merely hidden by sorting. Export-controlled: US advanced-computing rules apply to these parts, and Hong Kong-stock listings make destination screening a live issue.
